component.name: Route Flyover
component.summary: Turn a GPX track, photos and music into a 3D fly-over video

description.p: Drop in a GPX file from your ride, hike or drive, add the photos you took and a few songs, and Route Flyover flies a camera along your route over satellite imagery and 3D terrain, then renders a video ready to share. Everything stays on your computer.
The app runs a small local server and opens in your web browser.
